question: Did W1 cross Willow's release threshold, and why does the trace panel show16.95% while the completed-request counters support a different rate?

criteria.instruction: W1 is200/10000=2% of completed requests and does not cross a strictly greater-than2% threshold. The trace panel is200/1180≈16.95% in a failure-biased sample retaining all failures but10% successes; it is not the population rate. Use aligned unsampled counters; the40 in-flight requests are outside completed counts.
Join counter window, trace sampling policy and M6 strict threshold. Do not infer the panel percentage is arithmetic corruption; it is a ratio of a different selected population.
Do not assert zero errors because W1 did not cross the threshold, or call16.95% the customer/request population rate.
